info.title: VpnHood Resource Translator
info.description: AI-powered translator for i18n resource files (JSON, Microsoft .resx) and static Jekyll-style websites. Translates only what changed, preserves placeholders, HTML structure and formatting, verifies every translated page before writing it, and supports Google Gemini, OpenAI and Grok engines.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Translates i18n resource files (JSON or Microsoft .resx) using AI while preserving placeholders, HTML tags and formatting. Only entries whose source text changed are retranslated; missing entries in a target language are always filled in. To translate a static (Jekyll-style) website, use the 'site' command.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --base
options.description: Path to the base language file (.json / .resx) or a language folder (e.g. i18n/en): every resource file inside is translated to sibling language folders (i18n/fa, ...)

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to a vhtranslator.json file (default: nearest one found in the current or parent folders, also searched inside vh_translator/)

options.name: --extra-prompt
options.description: Path to extra instructions appended to the AI prompt

options.name: --show-changes
options.description: List what would be translated (changed and missing items) and exit; needs no API key [default: False]

options.name: --rebuild-lang
options.description: Force retranslation of everything for one language (e.g. 'fr'); on the 'site' command this covers the pages and all configured data files

options.name: --ignore-changes
options.description: Mark everything as already translated without calling the AI [default: False]

options.name: --api-key
options.description: API key (or set GEMINI_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY / GROK_API_KEY)

options.name: --model
options.description: AI model (default depends on the engine)

options.name: --engine
options.description: Translation engine: gemini, gpt, grok (default: detected from the model name)

options.name: --batch
options.description: Entries per translation request (default: 20)

commands.name: site
commands.description: Translates a static (Jekyll-style) website using AI, writing whole pages into per-language folders and keeping the configured i18n data files translated. Only pages whose source changed are retranslated; missing target pages are always filled in. Every page is structurally verified against its source and is never written when verification fails. Configured by the "site" section of vhtranslator.json.
